claim: A four-role executable cycle can form a probe-relative finite behavioral object, preserve it across relabeled perspectives, compress it to a congruent quotient, and reject a corrupted projection on frozen finite automata.
explicit_non_claims: four roles are not four QIT substages
four refinement rounds are not universally forced
the sixteen source slots or sixty-four microsteps are not earned by this battery
runtime personality, general perception, MMM admission, ontology admission, Axis0, physics, life, and consciousness are blocked

carrier.generator: Python random.Random(seed), two independent successor draws per base state
carrier.lift: state=(base,copy); probe ignores copy; both actions preserve copy while applying the base action

depth_census.interpretation: The census is a falsifier for universal four-count language. Four is rare in this family and no depth above four occurs in the frozen interval.

candidate_cycle.tooth: probe erasure must change at least one frozen target relation
depth-3 truncation must fail exact recovery on every depth-4 target

candidate_cycle.map: stable relation -> induced two-action quotient graph
candidate_cycle.tooth: quotient must preserve dynamics and reduce every lifted target from 64 states to at most 15 classes

candidate_cycle.map: candidate quotient + perspective receipts -> accept or reject
candidate_cycle.tooth: intact perspectives must pass and every frozen quotient corruption must be rejected

perspective_contract.views: four hidden state relabelings plus one action-swapped relabeling per fixture
perspective_contract.known_bijection_check: pull each relation back to the source carrier and require exact equality
perspective_contract.unlabeled_check: require color-preserving directed quotient-graph isomorphism without supplying the state bijection
perspective_contract.anti_projection: alter one induced quotient successor in each target view

engine_contract.julia_role: independent exact finite semantic owner and Graphs quotient verifier
engine_contract.jax_role: batched 20000-seed census, perspective sweep, and ablation workhorse
engine_contract.pytorch_role: excluded from this exact battery; a later learned-proxy battery consumes only frozen outputs
